claim.statement: For nonnegative integer numerators a,c and positive integer denominators b,d, a/b < c/d exactly when ad < cb; equality and greater-than follow the corresponding integer comparisons.
claim.proof: Multiplying a/b-c/d by the positive integer bd yields ad-cb. A positive multiplier preserves the sign; therefore the three comparisons are equivalent.
claim.boundary: Zero or negative denominators, noninteger inputs, Boolean values, unspecified expression, and values outside the declared finite fixture range are not processed. No learner mastery conclusion.

task.prompt: Compare two nonnegative fractions with positive denominators: choose LESS, EQUAL or GREATER.
task.scoring: Exact cross product comparison, no floating point, only integer inputs 0..100 with strictly positive denominators.
task.construct: Comparing fraction magnitudes, not reading speed or general mathematical proficiency.
